newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, Thai central bank heads to meet on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Japan, Thai central bank heads to meet on Thursday.

text.p: Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond will meet Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita on Thursday afternoon, the BOJ said.
Rerngchai, who arrived in Tokyo on Wednesday along with Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya, is expected to discuss the situation after the de facto devaluation of the Thai baht earlier this month.
Rerngchai and Thanong will also meet representatives of Japanese commercial banks on Thursday afternoon.

Thai Foreign Minister Prachuab Chaiyasarn, who was scheduled to visit Japan, cancelled the trip to attend a meeting in Beijing of Southeast Asian foreign ministers and Cambodia's King Norodom Sihanouk, a Thai embassy official in Tokyo said.
